parameters.name: DstDb
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance to which the migration object belongs in the target instance. > You can invoke the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all ApsaraDB RDS instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: DstPassword
parameters.description: The password of the privileged user for the destination ApsaraDB RDS instance. > * The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length. * The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. * Special characters include ! @ # $ & % ^ * ( ) _ + - =

parameters.name: DstUserName
parameters.description: The username used to connect to the target instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

parameters.name: SrcPassword
parameters.description: The password of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including the password.

parameters.name: SrcUserName
parameters.description: The username used to connect to the source instance (source database).
